lines.text: If you hear a woman scream in the Pine Barrens at night... don't go look. It's not a woman.
My uncle Ray had a cabin deep in the Pine Barrens, in South Jersey. Miles of pine trees. No signal.
Folks say a woman had thirteen kids out here. The last one grew wings and flew up the chimney.
He laughed. But that night, the dog wouldn't stop growling at the window.
Then we heard it. A scream. High and long. Like a woman, but wrong.
Uncle Ray grabbed his flashlight and went outside. I watched from the porch.
The light hit something on the roof of the shed. Hooves. Then a long tail. Then wings, like a giant bat.
And on top... the head of a horse. With red eyes.
Jake! Get inside! Lock the door!
It jumped into the sky, and the whole shed shook. We heard wings over the roof all night.
In the morning, there were hoof prints in the snow. On our roof. Going right to the chimney.
So if you're ever in the Pine Barrens at night, and you hear a woman scream... stay inside.
